summary: Off-registry self-named dependency fetches from attacker-controlled host at install time
details: package.json line 14 declares the package's sole dependency using its own name (`@bx-ui-framework/authentication`) resolved from a bare HTTPS URL (`https://repo.remoteknight.com/bx-ui-framework/authentication`) instead of a registry version range. On `npm install`, npm fetches whatever tarball that host returns and executes any lifecycle scripts contained in it, with no version pin, no lockfile hash, and no integrity check. The shipped index.js is an inert stub, so the manifest entry is the entire delivery mechanism. The dependency key equalling the package's own name is a dependency-confusion shape that forces resolution through the off-registry URL. Whoever controls repo.remoteknight.com controls code executed on any machine that installs this package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
